title: How Representational Priors Shape Generalization in World Action Models
title_zh: 表征先验如何塑造世界动作模型的泛化能力

paragraphs.en: 研究发现表征先验的干扰正交性可前瞻性预测世界动作模型的策略泛化能力。 World action models (WAMs) are shown to substantially diverge under generalization performance based on their generative backbones. We investigate this gap through the representational geometry that WAMs inherit from their backbones and how policy training reorganizes it. Our central hypothesis is that a useful representational prior would structure geometry that separates nuisance information from the in-distribution manifold in advance of training as a policy. We quantify this with nuisance orthogonality; orthogonality of the feature under visual variation outside the empirical in-distribution manifold. Across various image and video backbones, we show that a higher orthogonality from the representational prior is associated with stronger robustness to visual variations after WAM training, enabling policy generalization measurable prospectively for world models. In addition, analyzing the resulting robust WAMs reveals nuisance suppression; relative suppression of feature displacement caused by such variations and robust action generation of the policy. Together, these findings provide a geometric perspective on how the representational prior of the world model shapes the generalization performance of WAMs.
paragraphs.zh: 研究发现表征先验的干扰正交性可前瞻性预测世界动作模型的策略泛化能力。研究表明，世界动作模型（WAM）在泛化性能上因其生成式骨干网络的不同而存在显著差异。 我们通过世界动作模型从其骨干网络继承的表征几何，以及策略训练如何重组这种几何，来研究这一差距。 我们的核心假设是，一个有用的表征先验会在其作为策略训练之前，就构建出一种将干扰信息与经验分布内流形分离开来的几何结构。 我们用干扰正交性来量化这一点，即特征在经验分布内流形之外的视觉变化下的正交性。 通过对多种图像和视频骨干网络的实验，我们表明表征先验具有较高的正交性与世界动作模型训练后对视觉变化的更强鲁棒性相关，从而实现对世界模型策略泛化的前瞻性度量。 此外，对得到的鲁棒世界动作模型的分析揭示了干扰抑制，即对此类变化引起的特征位移的相对抑制，以及策略的鲁棒动作生成。 总之，这些发现为世界模型的表征先验如何塑造世界动作模型的泛化性能提供了一个几何视角。
